decisions.reason: The rotating-skip compact dumper extends the firm's established dumper range, which is meeting aspirations in a growing industry, and the firm has the slack to carry it while results are still forming.
The articulated construction dumper builds on core engineering and service capabilities, and with turnover growing and the firm hiring there is no shortfall to trigger problemistic search.

The mine rescue vehicle is distant from the core offer and serves an uncertain niche market, but organisational slack and its link to the firm's underground expertise justify keeping it for now despite a higher risk of falling short.
The multi-model compact telescopic loader line rests on the established lifting offer and represents a significant committed investment, so satisfactory performance makes withdrawal unlikely.
